summary: Validate record-building operations on schemas with implicit flattened layouts and huge repetitions.

traps.quote: Repetitions between 1 and 10^18. Flattened layouts may be enormous.
traps.consequence: Eagerly flattening all schemas causes memory exhaustion or timeout with 10^18 fields.
traps.guard: Represent flattened layouts implicitly; compute field positions without materializing full lists.

traps.quote: default fills next k positions; k and repetitions reach 10^18.
traps.consequence: Iterating k times causes timeout; can't determine which fields k spans without iteration.
traps.guard: Use modular arithmetic over repeat lengths to determine fields spanned; avoid iterating k.

traps.quote: Descriptor equality is recursive and includes schema indices and capacities.
traps.consequence: Comparing only element type misses capacity mismatch; Array(int,100) wrongly equals Array(int,50).
traps.guard: Recursively check all parts: element type, schema indices, and array capacities.

traps.quote: Record closes only when all flattened fields filled. Array may close at any length.
traps.consequence: Enforcing full array fill or allowing partial record fill incorrectly rejects valid operations.
traps.guard: Verify all record fields filled before closing; allow arrays to close at any fill level.

traps.quote: Return 1-based index of earliest invalid operation.
traps.consequence: Off-by-one errors return 0-based index or len(operations) when 1-based or len(operations)+1 required.
traps.guard: Use 1-based indexing consistently for operation numbering in all return paths.

traps.quote: Return 0 if valid and closed; len(operations)+1 if valid but open; else 1-based invalid index.
traps.consequence: Confusing the three cases returns wrong value: 0 when should be len+1, or invalid index when should be 0.
traps.guard: Clearly distinguish: return 1-based invalid index first, then 0 for closed, then len+1 for open.

input_shape: List of schemas with repeats, capacities up to 10^18; operation sequence; max 200k schemas, 300k terms.
output_shape: Integer: 1-based invalid operation index, 0 if all valid and closed, len(operations)+1 if open.
invariants: Flattened layouts with 10^18 repetitions cannot be materialized; must track position implicitly.
Records must have all fields filled to close; arrays close at any fill length.
Descriptor equality includes schema indices and array capacities, checked recursively.
max_scale: 200,000 schemas; 300,000 layout terms; 10^18 repetitions and capacities.
